name: cloudarmor-mcp
description: Cloud Armor MCP server, packaged as a Claude Code plugin.

plugins.name: cloudarmor-mcp
plugins.description: Google Cloud Armor WAF log patrol for Claude Code, straight from Cloud Logging. Summarize enforced DENYs per rule, flag home-region false positives, review preview (dry-run) rules, and get a one-shot daily_brief health check. All tools are read-only. Requires CLOUDARMOR_PROJECT and a GOOGLE_APPLICATION_CREDENTIALS service-account key file on the local machine.
